selection.rule: earliest prefix improving validation logloss by more than 1e-12

report.scope: Mean residual leaves. Deterministic Bernoulli boosting with greedy SSE residual trees and fixed shrinkage. Half-count smoothing for training-only initial prevalence. Validation selects the prefix, including zero trees. No line search, external data, test-based selection, missing-value handling, causal claims or production-performance guarantee.
